feature: Smart per-file diff assembly with ranking and per-file hunk guarantees
problem: Current diff assembly naively truncates the full diff string at 16K chars. Files with high defect-signal relevance may be cut off while unimportant build/config files fill the budget. Commit 572f3cee35fe demonstrates the failure: XmppGroupChatProducer.java (the defect-signal file) is truncated away before the LLM sees it.
proposed_solution: New smart_diff.py module: parse diff by file, rank files (defect_signal > production > test > build/config), allocate per-file minimum hunk budget (≥1 hunk per file), then fill remaining budget from top-ranked files. Result: AssembledDiff{text, included_files[], truncated_files[], total_chars}. context_builder injects it into InvestigationContext. Orchestrator reads assembled diff instead of raw diff[:16000].
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Per-file minimum hunk guarantee before global 16K cap (at least 1 hunk from each touched file up to budget)
AC-2: File ranking: defect_signal_files > other_production > test > build/config
AC-4: Fixture 572f3cee35fe: XmppGroupChatProducer.java hunk MUST be present in assembled diff
AC-5: Regression panel 12-commit: D1 ≥ 0.65, buggy recall ≥ 0.80 (no regression from iter-2a/iter-3b)
AC-6: Total cap unchanged at 16000 chars
AC-7: D6 ≥ 0.70 on 12-commit panel (script-only, no LLM)
edge_cases: EC-1: Single file commit — no ranking needed, full hunk up to cap
EC-2: All files are build/config — still include at least 1 hunk per file
EC-3: diff is None (e.g. merge commit) — return empty AssembledDiff with truncation_metadata
verification_method: pytest tests/test_smart_diff.py -v; pytest tests/test_panel_smart_diff.py -v; pytest -q for regression
